name: SVC_MCA_PHONE_CALLS_
description: The table stores phone calls made or received by the MCA framework.

columns.name: CALL_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: CALL_NUMBER
columns.description: Public Unique Identifier for an MCA Phone Call.

columns.name: INTERACTION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_INTERACTIONS (INTERACTION_ID).

columns.name: EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_CALL_ID
columns.description: Phone Call Identifier from the Telephony Provider System.

columns.name: PHONE_NUMBER
columns.description: The phone number dialed for outbound calls or the caller's phone number for inbound calls.

columns.name: LEFT_MESSAGE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a voice mail message was left (Y or N).

columns.name: CALL_RECORDING
columns.description: The recording of the phone conversation.

columns.name: RECORDING_FORMAT
columns.description: Phone conversation recording format.

columns.name: TRANSCRIPT_URL
columns.description: External Web address to access the Phone Conversation Transcript.

columns.name: RECORDING_URL
columns.description: External Web address to access the Phone Conversation Recording.

columns.name: CALL_DETAILS_URL
columns.description: External Web address to access the Phone Call Details.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
